newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: N. Korean defector leaves Manila - President Ramos.
newsitem.headline: N. Korean defector leaves Manila - President Ramos.

text.p: North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop left for South Korea on a chartered plane on Sunday after a 31-day refuge in the Philippines, President Fidel Ramos confirmed.
"I am pleased to announce that Hwang...departed from the Philippines early today for South Korea without any untoward incident," Ramos told a news briefing.
"I have said all along that Mr Hwang's stay here will only be as long as necessary and as short as possible," he added. He said Hwang was accompanied by his aide, Kim Dok Young.

Hwang, North Korea's top ideologue and the most senior official to flee the secretive Stalinist state, defected in Beijing on February 12 and has been in the Philippines since March 18 but his whereabouts had been a kept a tight secret on Manila's fears he might be a target of Pyongyang hitmen.
Soldiers shooed reporters away just before the Boeing 737 Air Philippines charter aircraft carrying Hwang took off at 7 a.m. local time (2300 gmt Saturday) from Manila's military air base.
